mr_description: To avoid looping over objs twice.

expected_issues.title: Objects partitioned before related fields are prepared in bulk_create()
expected_issues.description:
Objects are partitioned by primary-key presence before _prepare_related_fields_for_save() runs, so objects whose pk comes from a related instance saved late are put in the wrong bucket.

Previously the partition happened after every object had gone through _prepare_related_fields_for_save(), which copies the pk of a related object saved after instantiation (e.g. a OneToOne primary key). The refactor classifies each object before preparing its related fields, so such an object is treated as having no pk; bulk_create() then inserts it through the objs_without_pk path and fails the returned-rows assertion on backends that return rows (PostgreSQL). The preparation call must run before the classification.
